flags: Retrofit estimates use assumed end-use allocation and constant comfort/use; site assessment required.
India adaptation: appliance efficiency and cooling/hot water replace EPC and space-heating components; no certificate is predicted.
Carbon is operational CO2 only using a dated CEA national generation proxy, not complete lifecycle CO2e.

Rooftop solar site screening is preliminary and based on user declarations: at least 30 m2 usable roof area for illustrative 3 kW PV plus shading, structural and electrical suitability. Actual module/layout needs vary; this is not installation certification.

Engineering defaults were assumed for: ac_capacity_ton, ac_iseer, setpoint_c, roof_u_value, roof_exposed_fraction, wall_u_value, window_to_wall_ratio, window_shgc, window_shading_fraction, fan_count, fan_power_w, fan_hours_per_day, lighting_hours_per_day, hot_water_litres_per_person_day, appliance_kwh_per_day, solar_self_consumption_fraction. Inspect advanced inputs before interpreting estimates.
Gross electricity and PV self-use are separately accounted; exports receive no energy or carbon credit.
Weather uses NASA POWER single-year 2024 gridded data; PV generation uses the separate PVGIS ERA5 2005-2023 reference. Synthetic training labels remain simulated.
Hyderabad is the primary pilot. Space heating and humidity/latent cooling are not modeled; other cities are exploratory even though their weather/PV references are sourced.
Induction is a fuel-switch option: purchased energy may fall while operational CO2 rises; inspect signed per-fuel changes.

factors.basis: Operational CO2 only; generation national proxy; LPG and PNG net CV; excludes T&D, WTT and embodied emissions
factors.electricity_source_detail: CEA CO2 Baseline Database v19, Annexure I: 0.716 tCO2/MWh, including renewables/captive; dated proxy, not latest
factors.lpg_source_detail: IPCC 2006 Vol 2 Ch 2 Table 2.5: 63,100 kg CO2/TJ (net CV), multiplied by 0.0000036 TJ/kWh
factors.lpg_ncv_source_detail: IPCC 2006 Vol 2 Ch 1 Table 1.2: 47.3 TJ/Gg = 47.3 MJ/kg; 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ
factors.png_source_detail: IPCC 2006 Vol 2 Ch 2 Table 2.5: natural gas 56,100 kg CO2/TJ, net CV, multiplied by 0.0000036 TJ/kWh; delivered PNG composition can differ

anchor.electricity_anchor_rule: grid imports inverted through the assumed annual PV balance

pv_assumptions.generation_source: Cached PVGIS 5.3 ERA5 2005-2023, 20-degree south-facing, 14% user loss

equations: scale = anchored gross electricity / sum(nominal electrical end uses)
anchored end-use kWh = nominal end-use kWh * scale; these shares are inferred, not metered
PV generation = installed kW * location yield; self-use = min(generation * self-consumption fraction, 0.75 * gross demand)
grid imports = gross electricity - self-used PV; exports = generation - self-used PV; exports receive no savings credit
meter-only gross electricity = min(4 * grid imports, grid imports + generation * self-consumption fraction)
LPG and PNG retain the supplied fuel totals; their useful cooking heat is not scaled with electricity

discounted_payback.definition: First time-zero/year-end point where cumulative discounted net cash flow is non-negative and stays so through the modeled horizon; includes maintenance and replacements. No fractional-year interpolation.
